description: This file defines utility functions for comparing and manipulating Spark SQL DataTypes, including type compatibility checks, conversions, and schema path extraction.

classes.name: DataTypeUtils
classes.description: Utility object providing methods for comparing, converting, and manipulating Spark SQL DataTypes.

methods.name: sameType
methods.description: Checks if two DataTypes are the same, ignoring nullability.

methods.name: equalsIgnoreNullability
methods.description: Checks if two DataTypes are equal, ignoring nullability of complex types.

methods.name: equalsIgnoreCaseAndNullability
methods.description: Checks if two DataTypes are equal, ignoring nullability and case sensitivity in StructType field names.

methods.name: equalsIgnoreCaseNullabilityAndCollation
methods.description: Deep comparison of DataTypes, ignoring nullability, case sensitivity, and collation differences.

methods.name: canWrite
methods.description: Determines if data of the write type can be safely read as the read type, considering schema compatibility and policies.

methods.name: toAttribute
methods.description: Converts a StructField to an AttributeReference.

methods.name: toAttributes
methods.description: Converts a StructType schema into a sequence of AttributeReferences.

methods.name: fromAttributes
methods.description: Creates a StructType from a sequence of Attributes.

methods.name: fromLiteral
methods.description: Converts a Literal to a DecimalType.

methods.name: extractAllFieldPaths
methods.description: Recursively extracts all field paths from a nested StructType.

methods.name: extractLeafFieldPaths
methods.description: Extracts only leaf-level field paths from a nested StructType.

methods.name: areSameBaseType
methods.description: Checks if two StringTypes have the same base type (Char, Varchar, or String).

methods.name: replaceDefaultStringCharAndVarcharTypes
methods.description: Replaces default STRING/CHAR/VARCHAR types without explicit collation with specified collation.

methods.name: isDefaultStringCharOrVarcharType
methods.description: Checks if a DataType is STRING, CHAR, or VARCHAR without explicit collation.
